data.context: In the 2024 IP Australia Economic Research Paper 16, *Computer implemented inventions: patent trends at IP Australia, EPO and USPTO*, this passage compares characteristics of computer-implemented invention (CII) patent applications at IP Australia, the EPO and the USPTO from 2001 to 2020. It reports claims, IPC classifications, divisional and PCT application shares, and assignee counts by CII and likely-PSM-objection group.
